content: Inioxoadipi, Aneotedoɡ̶oji ɡ̶adiolaatedicoace makaami nepilidi, codaa eniditedaɡ̶awa midioka limedi me ideoni miniwataɡ̶a, odaa ina boɡ̶owoo Jesus, Niɡ̶ijoa liiɡ̶exegi Aneotedoɡ̶oji, jiɡ̶iniaa ɡ̶onisacerdoti ane daɡ̶axa me ɡ̶oneɡ̶egi, okotawece ane jinakatonaɡ̶a.

Aneotedoɡ̶oji iolatedice meote niɡ̶ida libakedi me ɡ̶onisacerdoti ɡ̶oneɡ̶egi, odaa idioka limedi meote inoatawece Aneotedoɡ̶oji ane iiɡ̶ete meote, digo mijotaɡ̶a Moisés midioka limedi meo ijoatawece niɡ̶ijoa Aneotedoɡ̶oji ane iiɡ̶ete meote me libaketedi liwigotigi Aneotedoɡ̶oji loiigi.

Niɡ̶ina oko ane dabiteɡ̶etini diimigi daɡ̶axa moiweniɡ̶ide caticedi niɡ̶ini diimigi loenatagi. Jiɡ̶idaaɡ̶ee Jesus leeditibige moiweniɡ̶ide caticedi Moisés, leeɡ̶odi liciagi niɡ̶ijo ane dabiteɡ̶etini diimigi.
Natigide okanicodaaɡ̶ica diimigi ini noenatagodi, pida Niɡ̶ijoa ane yoe inoatawece baɡ̶a Aneotedoɡ̶oji.
Moisés idioka limedi mele me diba liwigotigi loiigi Aneotedoɡ̶oji, micataɡ̶a daɡ̶a niotagi ane dibatigi diimigi. Ikee niɡ̶ica Aneotedoɡ̶oji ane yatemati nigidiaaɡ̶idi.

Pida Cristo baɡ̶a daɡ̶axa me ɡ̶oneɡ̶egi caticedi okanicodaaɡ̶ica niotagi. Igaataɡ̶a eote ijoatawece niɡ̶ijoa Aneotedoɡ̶oji ane iiɡ̶ete meote, micataɡ̶a niɡ̶ina nionigi ane dowediteloco diimigi. Oko baɡ̶a ɡ̶odiciagi niɡ̶ini diimigi, nigidioka limedi mabo ɡ̶odaaleɡ̶ena, codaa nigidioka limedi me jinakatonaɡ̶a mida ɡ̶onaɡ̶ajegi ane inibeoonaɡ̶atege.
Odaa digawini ane ligegi Liwigo Aneotedoɡ̶oji, mee,

content.text: miditaɡ̶a nipodigi ane yadilo ane diɡ̶icata niɡ̶eladimigipi,
idaaɡ̶ee monadi libinico ane jaote niɡ̶ijoatigilo cwareenta nicaaɡ̶ape.
Joaniɡ̶idaa leeɡ̶odi me idelatema niɡ̶ijo noiigi,
“Niɡ̶idi aɡ̶ica ane yakadi micota niɡ̶idi nipenaɡ̶adi

content: Inioxoadipi, adowetita adiɡ̶ica niɡ̶ina akaamitiwaji ane abeyaceɡ̶e laaleɡ̶ena aneo me daɡ̶a nakatoteda Ǥoniotagodi, codaa niɡ̶ida niciagi ɡ̶adadeegiticogi ditigedi motonitedice Aneotedoɡ̶oji, Niɡ̶ijoa ewikegi.

Pida akamaɡ̶akaami adinoniciwaɡ̶atitiwage inoatawece nokododi maleeɡ̶akati majipaata ligegi Aneotedoɡ̶oji, amanagawini aɡ̶icoa niɡ̶ina akaamitiwaji ane dakake laaleɡ̶ena, leeɡ̶odi libeyaceɡ̶eco ane inaale.
Igaataɡ̶a oko lokaaɡ̶etedipi Cristo nige idokee me jinakatonaɡ̶a nigepaa ɡ̶odiniogo, digo mijotaɡ̶a me jinakatonaɡ̶a maleekoka joleeɡ̶atibige me jinakatonaɡ̶a.

content.text: mijotaɡ̶a anee jotigide ɡ̶adaamipi noɡ̶odakapetege Aneotedoɡ̶oji,

content: Amiidi ica anowajipatalo Aneotedoɡ̶oji odaa niɡ̶idiaaɡ̶idi ja nakapetegi? Ijotawece niɡ̶ijo oko ane noɡ̶aticoace Moisés me ideitice Egito.
Amiidi ica Aneotedoɡ̶oji ane yelatetema icoatigilo cwareenta nicaaɡ̶ape? Yelatetema niɡ̶ijo anowote loenataka ane beyagi odaa ja nigo miditaɡ̶a nipodigi ane yadilo ane diɡ̶icata niɡ̶eladimigipi.

Niɡ̶ijo Aneotedoɡ̶oji neɡ̶eote ligegitediogi ica noiigi me doɡ̶oyakadi motota ane yoetetema me nipenaɡ̶adi loiigi, amiidi ica aneetediogi Aneotedoɡ̶oji? Eetetece Aneotedoɡ̶oji niɡ̶ijo ane doɡ̶oyiwaɡ̶aditeda.
Odaa ja jinataɡ̶a aɡ̶oyakadi motota niɡ̶ica nipodigi Aneotedoɡ̶oji ane yemaa me yajigotediogi loiigi, leeɡ̶odi me doɡ̶onakatoteda.
